objective: Implement secure permanent BUKLOD participation-sourced virtual-material marketplace: verified item acquisition, business registration, staged L1–L10 construction, atomic existing-BP item transfers, Rank-only verified net profit; preserve original Market and World DEV efforts.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main at 536741f8d97fc9dec91503c89f1c1160e5987ce0 read-only inspected on Nov 21. Connected live Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu inspected read-only for wallet, point-ledger unique constraints and claim states. The exact installed production OTA/runtime/ad rendering and staged database test-run evidence are NOT verified. No production migrations or OTA are authorized. Concurrent DEV PRs #1039 (real-world Palengke), #1041 (character item gates) and #1042 (preview-only World) remain unreleased.
chosenApproach: Add isolated virtual-BP routes under existing Focus Apps, server RPCs with default-off flags and private RLS inventory/listing/transfer tables, distinctive audit receipts and buyer point debits via existing trigger, progressive business levels with 5 visible material-consuming stages, and capped delayed Rank-only net profit. Preserve canonical Market/Business routes so PR #1039 does not conflict. Do not apply migrations on live Supabase; review against isolated staging first. Preserve World/Character ownership authorities; reconcile stages and placement in later integrated RC.
selectionRationale: Safest viable bounded implementation under source-only GitHub access. Existing points ledger has UNIQUE(user_id, source_key) and a claim_state CHECK limited to legacy/pending/claimed: therefore use unique event keys and a separate BP transfer receipt instead of altering ledger constraints or manufacturing claimable credits. Use separate isolated table family to prevent double spend and facilitate reversible release gating.
alternativeApproaches: Patch existing points/QMP/Finance earning and rank triggers or create member-to-member reward credits (rejected: arbitrary mint, existing claim state/unique constraints and production regression risk).
Overwrite PR #1039 Palengke/PR #1042 World routes and directly activate combined market (rejected: concurrent DEV work, ownership duplication and missing verified staging).
Chosen: separate feature-off virtual economy RPCs and existing Focus Apps navigation, with verified integration via RC after schema/adversarial QA.
preserveBehaviors: No newly minted or paid BP from business transactions; QMP, cash/Bayanihan, monthly financial settlement unchanged.
Lifetime Rank not deducted by spending; supplier profit Rank credit never alters spendable BP beyond actual received sale payment.
Existing Market Palengke route/reservation/Wall promo from PR #1039 remains unchanged and separate from virtual BP trade.
Original Character collectible and evolution item authorities unchanged; no tradable conversion of 1,300 story collectibles.
Existing World L1–10 preview, neighbor views and Cluster treasury policies not falsely represented as live; no new bottom navigation.
Existing AdMob first-view/navigation, Wall, Connect, user auth, staging/runtime identity, and all production data preserved.
Trade grants, stock and BP must be server-owned, account-isolated, idempotent and atomic; no direct new table writes by clients.
acceptanceChecks: Existing BP ledger unique source keys and restricted claim states untouched; seller receipt uses dedicated non-reward transfer table.
Production flags remain disabled even if migrations are safely applied later; unauthenticated and direct table writes denied.
Only claimed eligible participation source can mint one material receipt; faith-neutral item path exists.
Business requires 5 verified participation receipts, 40 available BP and orientation before L1; stages 1–5 visible each of 10 levels.
Buyer debit via existing debit trigger, seller available BP credit exactly once, escrow item movement exactly once under lock and buyer request key.
Actual item resale basis subtracts verified acquisition cost; net profit capped and delayed before Rank-only settlement.
All 11 changed paths only; focused Node and SQL tests pass in isolated staging; latest main and concurrent PRs reconciled.
DEV → verified RC → guarded staging → approved production only after true app/ad/navigation performance, Supabase integration tests and provider verification.

Future World lots/house/cluster plot allocation, privacy-safe neighbor labels, compound treasury pooled purchases and community scene rendering have distinct explicit integration gates and are NOT claimed implemented here.
